description: This file is a Java class implementing the ClientRepository interface with methods for CRUD operations on Client objects, utilizing Spring's caching annotations and dependency injection for a DAO component.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ClientRepository interface, providing methods to manage Client entities with caching support.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client by ID, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new Client record in the database.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing Client and refreshes the cache entry.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Removes a Client record and invalidates cache.
